claude.sample_unit: expert panel reviewers (evaluating AI-generated education materials for 3 disease cases)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education materials across iterative prompt refinement stages
links.effect: Readability scores significantly improved from 48.5 to 66.8 (Ateşman's Readability Index) after the three-stage nurse-led prompt process.
links.quote: Readability scores significantly improved from 48.5 to 66.8.

links.outcome: Clinical accuracy/hallucination mitigation and content validity of AI patient education after nurse clinical refinement
links.effect: Protocol mitigated AI hallucinations; expert panel (n=3) consensus Content Validity Index 0.93-0.95 indicated clinical safety.
links.quote: High expert consensus (CVI: 0.93-0.95) demonstrated clinical safety, proving nursing expertise is a mandatory safety layer.
